summary: Add an opt-in DX11 source-resolution A/B launch policy. Desktop remains the default A path; XR_NATIVE_2496X2688 is the bounded B candidate and passes -width 2496 -height 2688 plus MirrorFitDesktop=true so the game internal backbuffer can match the last observed Quest 3/VDXR recommended per-eye target while the PC mirror remains monitor-fitted. This does not promote the policy without HMD A/B evidence and does not activate NativeDrawPath.

C1_REVIEW.finding: DX11 plan priority #1 cadence already has automatic XR-native launch settings; remaining smoothness proof is runtime dependent. Priority #2 source-render resolution decoupling is the highest-priority independently executable unit. Existing post-config -width/-height overrides feed Game::screen_resolution before D3D initialization, and MirrorFitDesktop preserves the internal backbuffer while fitting the PC window, so an opt-in launcher A/B boundary avoids risky new device hooks.
